name: badge
title: Badge
description: A short status, category or count label: six tones, an icon or a status dot, two sizes.
whenToUse: Short status, category or count labels next to content: Paid, Trial · 5 days, Beta, 12.
notFor: A number that changes live (slot-text inside your own label).

keyboard: Not focusable; it labels, it does not act.
spec.motion: None: badges sit in dense tables and must cost nothing.

props.name: tone
props.description: Semantic colour; pair it with a word or icon (colour is never the only signal).

props.name: dot
props.description: A leading status dot in the tone colour (instead of an icon).

scopeDefaults.precedence: Instance prop, then nearest UIRoot.defaults entry, then existing component fallback. Only presentation keys are accepted; values, callbacks and operational state remain caller-owned.

spec.appearance: className/style address the visual root; typed classNames addresses documented closed internal parts. Public refs retain the actual native root.

notes: Nesting input (O1 §14.1, as Button): reads --pui-nest-radius / --pui-nest-inset from a parent and rounds to max(0, radius − inset); otherwise its own corner. --pui-badge-radius overrides both.
